details:
Machines Left in Space is an educational storytelling project developed by Team #kampung, represented by Nor Sufiyya and Nor Medina, for the NASA Space Apps Challenge Kuala Lumpur 2026.

Our project brings NASA's space exploration history to life through engaging infographics, interactive storytelling and STEM-based learning activities. Featuring iconic space machines such as the Apollo Lunar Rover, Sojourner, Perseverance and Voyager 1, we explore their missions, discoveries and technological contributions, highlighting how these machines continue to inspire scientific exploration.

Beyond storytelling, we aim to develop affordable, accessible and reusable STEM educational materials, including hands-on activities, engineering challenges, interactive games and classroom learning kits. These resources are designed particularly for schools in rural and underserved communities across Malaysia, where exposure to space science and advanced technologies may be limited.

The name #kampung reflects our commitment to ensuring that every child, regardless of geographical location or background, has opportunities to discover science, technology and innovation.

By connecting space exploration with practical STEM education, our project encourages curiosity, creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving while inspiring future scientists, engineers and innovators.

Our mission: Bringing space exploration to every kampung, inspiring young minds to dream beyond Earth.
